title: Labuschagne dropped as Australia names ODI squad for African series
description: Australia has named its ODI squad for its back-to-back series in Zimbabwe and South Africa later this month, with five players dropped, including World Cup winner Marnus Labuschagne.

title: Cricketer’s bail: HC no to urgent hearing
description: Calcutta High Court refused urgent hearing on Bengal cricketer Abishek Porel’s bail plea in an alleged rape case, citing serious allegations and directing him to file bail in HC.
author: Srishti Lakhotia

title: Red Sox announcer apologizes for ’emotional’ comments about Jazz Chisholm
description: The WEEI announcer wanted the Red Sox pitcher to drill the batter.
author: Stephen Douglas

title: HC dismisses Yusuf Pathan's plea over Vadodara land claim
description: The Gujarat high court on Monday dismissed as withdrawn a plea of former India cricketer and Lok Sabha MP Yusuf Pathan's appeal against a single judge order passed in August last year, calling him an "encroacher" on a piece of government land in Vadodara.
author: sports@rediff.co.in (Senjo MR)

title: 'In shambles': Cricket world reacts as Pakistan make 7 changes in squad in the middle of disastrous England tour
description: Pakistan shocked the world as they sent seven players back to the subcontinent in the middle of the Test series after being demolished at Lord's.
author: Deepanjan Mitra

title: Playoffs and final shifted from Kanpur to Ekana Stadium Lucknow due to forecast of more showers
description: UP T20 League shifts playoffs and final from Kanpur’s Green Park to Lucknow’s Ekana Stadium due to persistent rain; league matches stay in Kanpur.
author: The Times Of India
